question: An adversary makes a non-privileged mobile app load arbitrary code via hooking to bypass root/jailbreak checks and evade detection. Which MITRE ATT&CK technique corresponds to this behavior, and why does it map to it?
answer:
- T1055.
- T1055 corresponds to injecting/hooking code into a process, mapping CAPEC-660: loading arbitrary code to bypass root/jailbreak detection.
